content: Current Blossom BUD-01/02/11 specify SHA-256-addressed GET/HEAD retrieval, exact-byte PUT upload, descriptors containing URL/hash/size/type/uploaded time, CORS, and optional signed kind-24242 authorization scoped by expiration, action, server, and blob hash. Delivery should verify returned bytes against the advertised hash; Blossom failure can safely fall back to local serving.
